AUTHOR: Fleuré
TITLE: Automated identification of invasive rabbitfishes in underwater images from the Mediterranean Sea
REGION: Northern Crete (Greece) and Gulf of Lion (France), Mediterranean Sea
SPECIES: Siganus luridus, S. rivulatus + 6 native species (Chromis chromis, Diplodus sargus, D. vulgaris, Sarpa salpa, Sparisoma cretense, Thalassoma pavo); 5 unseen species in test
DATA: Own remote GoPro videos, EXOFISHMED campaigns 2017, 2019, 2020 (40 training videos, 9 test videos)
V_EV: Sec. 2.1: 'cameras were set up on the sea floor in shallow (1-5 m deep) coastal habitats'; 'varying hydrological conditions (turbidity and light)'
D2: train 40 videos (Oct 2019 Crete + 1 France video), test 9 videos (France 2017/2020, Crete June 2019); 31,285 train images, 2,159+100 test images
D_EV: Sec. 2.1: 'the two datasets were built using videos recorded in different locations or seasons (Table 1)'
R_EV: Sec. 2.1: 'For the testing dataset, nine videos recorded in France (July 2017 and May 2020) and in Crete (June 2019) were used.' (no in-domain test reported)
C_EV: Sec. 2.3: 'images with a confidence score lower than 0.8 were transferred to an unsure class. The recall was computed after removing these unsure images.'
E_EV: Results: 'On the four videos with at least one Siganus individual, the Siganus genus was detected in at least one frame (84% up to 100% of Siganus spp. were detected per video).'
ARCH: ResNet50 image classifier on cropped single-fish images
METR: Per-class recall and precision, confusion matrix, FP rate on unseen species, image-area analysis
NOTE: Test videos come from different campaigns (2017, 2020 France; June 2019 Crete vs Oct 2019 training) -> R1=Y (season + site + unseen species); only external test performance reported, no in-domain benchmark -> R3=N. D1 coded 영상(video); the split is also by campaign/season/location (any choice gives D_ALL=Y). Unsure class (<0.8) is the reject mechanism (C4=Y) and justified threshold -> C_ALL=P; expert checking is only hypothetical (no C5). E1=점유 based on video-level presence detection vs annotated presence (borderline; a stricter coder may use E1=없음 -> E_ALL=N). E4: FN counts and TP/FP by image area (apparent size, not body length). NIMG counts training images only.
AUTHORS_FULL: Fleuré, V; Magneville, C; Mouillot, D; Villéger, S
